goalsHint: You can pick more than one.

cycle.title: Understand my cycle
cycle.desc: Know which phase I'm in and what it means.

support.title: Emotional support
support.desc: Be there for me on the harder days.

mood.title: When I'm not feeling great
mood.desc: No judgement, never blamed on the period.

energy.title: When my energy is low
energy.desc: So things can be a little lighter.

sleep.title: When my sleep has been off

food.title: Food & drinks
food.desc: A warm drink or a favourite snack.

gift.title: Attention & small gifts
gift.desc: A kind message or a small gift.

time.title: Time together
time.desc: Time for two, a film or a walk.

calm.title: Closeness & calm
calm.desc: Listening without judgement, or giving some space.

family.title: Your family
family.pending: Once {name} accepts, your family is created.
family.childrenShared: {names} {count, plural, one {is your shared child} other {are your shared children}} and {count, plural, one {appears} other {appear}} in both panels.
family.childrenNone: No child is shared yet. You can pick shared children on your spouse's page.

banner.title: Invite your companion to Ritme
banner.body: Let someone who matters to you support you better.

list.title: My companions
list.emptyBody: Invite your spouse, a friend or a family member. They only see what you choose, and you can disconnect any time.
list.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
list.note: Each companion is linked only to you and can see who they're linked to. Either of you can disconnect.

intro.title: A gentle way to stay close
intro.lead: Share your cycle phase with a spouse, friend or family member who also uses Ritme.

choose.title: They only see what you choose
choose.body: In the next steps you decide exactly what is shown.

code.title: The invite code is valid for 24 hours
code.body: It works once, and you can cancel it before it's used.

intro.consent: I agree to share the cycle information I choose with the companion I invite.

goal.title: What would you most like your companion to be there for?
goal.lead: This only shapes the content and suggestions; it's never a medical diagnosis or prediction, and you can change it any time.

spouse.title: They're my spouse
spouse.desc: You form a family and can pick shared children in the next step.

children.question: Which child is shared?
children.lead: The child you pick is added to both of your panels and you become one family.
children.emptyTitle: You haven't added a child yet
children.emptyBody: Add your child in the «Child» section; then you can share them from your spouse's page. For now, continue without it.

access.title: Which sections can your companion access?
access.lead: Pick one for each section: hidden, view only, or view and edit. You can change it any time.
access.hidden: A section left on «hidden» is never shown to your companion.
access.note: With «view and edit» on medications or appointments, your companion can choose to log for themselves or for you.

actions.title: What kind of support feels best to you?
actions.lead: We'll suggest these to your companion more often. None is required, and your companion can tone suggestions down too.

contact.hint: So you recognise them in your list, or so we can text them the code.
contact.name: Their name
contact.namePlaceholder: The name you'll see in Ritme
contact.phoneHint: If you add a number, the code is also sent to them by SMS.
contact.phoneInvalid: The mobile number must start with 09 and have 11 digits.

generating.title: Creating your code
generating.lead: Your companion gets a link to install Ritme, then connects your profiles with this code.
generating.wait: Stay on this screen until the code is ready.
generating.privacy: Your data matters — only share it with someone you trust.
generating.error: Couldn't create the invite code. Try again.

code.title: Send the code to your companion
code.smsSent: The code was also texted to <ltr>{phone}</ltr>.
code.smsNotSent: The SMS wasn't sent — send them the code yourself.

preview.title: This is what your companion sees
preview.lead: A read-only view based on exactly what you chose.
preview.estimate: Based on current data, the next period is estimated in about {days} days.
preview.noEstimate: No estimate of the next period is shown.

code.title: Invite code
code.label: Invite code {code}
code.shareText:
My Ritme companion code: {code}
Install Ritme here: {url}
code.failed: Couldn't copy — write the code down from the screen.
code.once: This code is shown only now.
code.accessNote: This code works once; your companion only gets access to the sections you chose.

detail.title: Companion
detail.notFoundBody: They may have been removed already.
detail.accessLead: Changes apply the next time your companion opens the app.
detail.renewNote: A new code stops the previous one from working.
detail.renewError: Couldn't make a new code. Try again.
detail.prefsLead: The goal, the states they see and the kind of support you like. Change them whenever you want.
detail.signalsLead: Each one is a separate consent. Your general cycle phase comes from the access section.
detail.childrenLead: The children you pick show up in your spouse's panel, view only.

disconnect.title: What happens when you disconnect?
disconnect.noData: {name} will no longer see your information.
disconnect.again: You can invite them again whenever you like.
disconnect.doneBody: {name} no longer sees any of your data. You can invite them again whenever you like.

privacy.pending: {count, plural, one {# invite waiting} other {# invites waiting}}

recordFor.title: Who are you adding this for?

selfDesc.meds: Goes into your own medication plan

recordFor.note: Only people who gave you “view and edit” access to this section appear here.

savedBody.meds: {name} sees this medication in her plan and gets a notice about it.
savedBody.appointments: {name} sees this appointment in her list and gets a notice about it.

recordFor.revoked: You no longer have edit access to this section, so nothing was saved. Your access list has been refreshed.
recordFor.forbidden: You don't have access to this item. Your access may have changed.
recordFor.viewOnly: You can only view this section, so changes can't be saved.

periodDays.label: Companion calendar
periodDays.title: Likely period days
periodDays.desc: Your companion sees in his calendar which days your period is likely to fall on. Upcoming predictions only — no history, no cycle numbers.
periodDays.needsCycle: To see these days, he also needs the “Cycle” section shared in access.
